title: Best Auckland Day Trips for Families — Within 2 Hours of the CBD
meta_desc: Discover the best Auckland day trips for families within 2 hours of the CBD, including Waiheke Island and Hobbiton
intro: Looking for a quick escape from Auckland city with your family? You don't have to go far to find stunning beaches, adventure activities, and unique experiences. Within 2 hours of the CBD, you can find a range of exciting day trip destinations that are perfect for families.

sections.heading: Waiheke Island Day Trip
sections.body: Waiheke Island is a popular day trip destination from Auckland, known for its beautiful beaches, vineyards, and olive groves. The ferry ride from Auckland CBD takes around 35 minutes and costs $42 return per adult and $22 return per child (5-15 years). You can spend the day exploring the island, visiting wineries, and enjoying the beach.

sections.heading: Waitomo and Hobbiton Day Trip
list: Drive time from Auckland CBD: 2 hours to Waitomo and 2.5 hours to Matamata
Cost: $199 per adult and $99 per child (9-15 years) for a guided tour of Waitomo Glowworm Caves and Hobbiton Movie Set
Age range: Suitable for children aged 5 years and above

sections.heading: Coromandel Day Trip
sections.body: The Coromandel Peninsula is a scenic 2-hour drive from Auckland CBD, offering a range of activities such as hiking, swimming, and visiting Hot Water Beach. You can also take a guided tour to explore the peninsula's hidden gems.

rows: $42 return per adult, $22 return per child
Free - $50 per person for guided tours

sections.heading: Piha Day Trip
sections.body: Piha is a popular beach town on the West Coast, just an hour's drive from Auckland CBD. You can spend the day swimming, surfing, and exploring the nearby Waitakere Ranges. Admission to the beach is free, but you may need to pay for parking and activities such as surfing lessons.

cta.text: Use our NZ Family Travel Budget Calculator to plan your day trip

sections.heading: Accommodation and Transport Options
sections.body: If you're planning to stay overnight at your destination, consider booking a campervan or hotel. You can also rent a car or take public transport to get to your destination. Check out our campervan and destinations pages for more information.
